description: Navigate a tab to a URL and wait for the page to load. Like a browser, a network failure or an empty HTTP error response leaves Chromium's error page in the tab and is reported in `error` rather than failing the call. A url that is a file downloads instead: the call returns once the download begins, with `download` set, and the tab stays on its page. Element refs from earlier snapshots are invalidated by navigation.

timeout_ms.description: Upper bound on the navigation wait; clamped to `max_timeout_ms`.

url.description: Absolute URL; scheme must be on the configured allowlist.

download.description: Set when the url was a file: Chromium downloaded it instead of loading a page, and the tab stays on the page it was on. The file is listed by `browser::downloads::list`; read it with `browser::download` and this guid once it completes.

error.description: Chromium's error text when the navigation ended on the browser's own error page: a network failure (`net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED`), or an empty HTTP error response (`net::ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE_CODE_FAILURE`, a 4xx/5xx with no body). Like a browser, the tab still shows that page and stays usable.

ok.description: False when the tab shows Chromium's error page instead of the site; see `error`.

timed_out.description: True when the load event did not fire inside the timeout; the page may still be usable; snapshot to check.

BeganDownload.description: A download the tab's main frame began: what `browser::navigate` reports when the url it was given turned out to be a file.

refused.description: The origin policy refused it: nothing was saved.
